design_title: El Faro en Oregon - Elecciones 2026 Flagship Homepage Redesign Blueprint
context: Civic & News Platform / Flagship Elections Section Redesign
theme: Dual Light/Dark Support with Forest Green (#143E2B) & Terracotta (#C85A32) Accent Palette

target_section.name: Elecciones 2026 / Conoce a los candidatos
target_section.location: Homepage - Positioned directly below Hero as the primary flagship moment
target_section.goal: Transform into an authoritative, institutional, non-partisan, attention-grabbing flagship banner that establishes civic trust while standing out visually from all other content blocks.

font_families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

scale.eyebrow: text-xs font-sans font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-terracotta dark:text-terracotta
scale.flagship_heading: font-serif text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-foreground leading-[1.15] tracking-tight
scale.subtitle: text-base sm:text-lg text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed max-w-2xl
scale.card_title: font-serif text-lg font-bold text-foreground group-hover:text-primary transition-colors

visual_enhancers.flagship_container_styling: relative overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-primary/20 dark:border-primary/40 bg-gradient-to-br from-secondary/80 via-background to-primary/5 p-6 sm:p-10 lg:p-14 shadow-xl shadow-primary/5
visual_enhancers.subtle_watermark: Absolute backdrop text or civic icon opacity effect (e.g. oversized low-opacity Vote icon in container corner) to ground the institutional tone.
visual_enhancers.card_elevation: bg-card border border-border/80 hover:border-terracotta/40 rounded-2xl p-6 text-center transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1.5 hover:shadow-xl hover:shadow-terracotta/5 group relative flex flex-col items-center justify-between
visual_enhancers.avatar_frame: relative mb-4 h-24 w-24 sm:h-28 sm:w-28 overflow-hidden rounded-full ring-4 ring-primary/10 group-hover:ring-terracotta/50 transition-all duration-300 shadow-md group-hover:scale-105

grids.candidates_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-5 sm:gap-6
grids.header_flex: flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-end justify-between gap-6 pb-8 border-b border-border/60 mb-8 sm:mb-10

section_structure: 1. Outer Container: section with data-testid='section-elecciones' className='max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-12 py-12 sm:py-16'
2. Flagship Frame: div with rounded-3xl, gradient background, border, shadow, and relative overflow-hidden

3. Header Block: Eyebrow badge 'Elecciones 2026' with Vote icon, H2 title 'Conoce a los candidatos', Subtitle 'Información neutral y equivalente para todos. Toca un candidato para ver su perfil y propuestas.', and CTA Button 'Comparar propuestas' (data-testid='conocer-candidatos-btn') linked to /elecciones
4. Non-Partisan Integrity Banner: A small subtle trust indicator ('Plataforma cívica e independiente · Todos los candidatos cuentan con el mismo espacio')
5. Candidate Grid: div with data-testid='home-candidates' rendering up to 8 candidate cards with data-testid='home-candidate-${c.id}'
6. Empty State: Tasteful civic notice card 'Pronto publicaremos a los candidatos' if array is empty

motion.entrance: fade-up entry animation on section scroll into view

accessibility.color_contrast: Ensure party text and neutral subtitles maintain > 4.5:1 ratio on both light and dark card backgrounds.
accessibility.aria_labels: aria-label provided for candidate profile links and primary CTA button

media.avatar_fallback: Round initial avatar with Lora serif initial on warm secondary background if c.photo is absent
media.image_optimization: Use mediaUrl(c.photo) helper with lazy loading and object-cover fit

3d_libraries.usage: Not required for civic non-partisan guide; prioritize clean, fast rendering, smooth CSS hover transitions, and accessible typography.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the Elections 2026 section in /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx (under data-testid='section-elecciones').
Preserve all required testids: section-elecciones, conocer-candidatos-btn, home-candidates, home-candidate-${c.id}.
Display round candidate photo (or initial fallback), full name, party (in terracotta), office/cargo title, and 'Ver perfil →'.
Add a non-partisan trust seal/banner ('Información neutral y equivalente para todos') to communicate non-partisan authority.
Keep styling consistent with index.css CSS variables (--primary, --terracotta, --secondary, --card, --border).
Support dark mode cleanly via Tailwind dark: variants and CSS variables.
Do NOT modify or remove the search bar / hero behavior or breaking changes elsewhere in Home.jsx.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for testing.
Never use pure black (#000000) or un-tinted grays.
Never use universal transition: all; target specific properties like transition-transform, transition-colors, transition-shadow.
Do NOT center align text globally or in top-level containers; use explicit alignment.
Ensure padding inside containers with borders so text never collides with edges.
Ensure hover states explicitely set text color to avoid invisible text in dark or light mode toggles.
